d.ko: Men of War: AS2는 새로운 난전 임무, 대규모 멀티플레이 전투, 향상된 비주얼, 개선된 AI, 완전한 직접 조작 기능으로 실시간 전술 시리즈를 확장합니다. 65개 맵에서 5개 진영, 250대 차량, 200종의 병력을 지휘하며 가장 정교한 WWII RTS 경험을 제공합니다.
d.en: Men of War: Assault Squad 2 expands the real-time tactics series with new skirmish missions, massive multiplayer battles, enhanced visuals, improved AI, and full Direct Control. Command five factions across 65 maps, 250 vehicles, and 200 soldiers in one of the most detailed WWII RTS experiences.
d.zh: Men of War: AS2 为即时战术系列带来新的遭遇战任务、大规模多人战斗、强化画面、更智能的 AI 以及完整的直接操控。指挥五个阵营，在 65 张地图、250 辆载具和 200 种士兵中体验最细致的二战 RTS 之一。

rv.t: 옛날서부터 알아본 게임이지만 확실히 컴퍼니 오브 히어로즈 시리즈보다 재밌습니다.

Tentative thumbs up, but know what you are getting into. This is a 10+ year old game on a 32 bit exe with the resource limits inherent to that meaning it can tend to crash if you do anything more than vanilla on standard settings. …
Even though this is an old game, it still works. I have over 1,000 hours on it. I like the way you can adjust game speed (although it seems Skirmish mode you can't, at least for me).
